title.narrative: Guarantee contribution for Ambatovy Nickel Project i Madagascar (second and final guarantee call)

description.narrative:
This engagement covers Denmark's final contribution to the guarantee call for the European Investment Bank's (EIB) loan to the Ambatovy Nickel Project i Madagascar. This is the second and final guarantee call for the project: Denmark contributed EUR 1,081,334.78 (app. DKK 8,064,919.19) in Q4, 2024.
In the EU's partnership agreement with the Organisation of Africa, Caribien and Pacific States (OACPS) from 2000 (the "Cotonou Agreement"), the EIB received a mandate to support private sector development in the partner countries through financial instruments, such as loans. With the signature of the Cotonou Agreement, and with the related Guarantor Agreement between the European Member states (EUMS) and EIB, the EUMS pledged to act as guarantors for the EIB's loans in the partner countries. When the EIB cannot fully cover losses via its own account, it issues guarantees from the EUMS. These calls are withdrawn from the EUMS "Member States Call Accounts" (MSCA). If a MSCA becomes negative, it has to be replenished. Until then, it will be subject to negative interest rates and arrear administration fees.
The Ambatovy Nickel project was created in 2007 under the 1st financial protocol of the Cotonou Agreement. In this protocol, the Danish percentage guarantee obligation towards the EIB was set to be 2.493522% of the total guarantee contribution.
For the second guarantee call, this amounts to approximately DKK 16,211,865.1 (EUR 2,173,172.26). Due to a lengthy case management process where the MFA consulted the EIB and other EUMS regarding the guarantee administration, the payment was approved and granted in Q2, 2025. Due to arrear administration fees, the outstanding amount was app. 16.450.499,2 kr. (2.205.160,75 EUR) when the payment was conducted in May, 2025. In addition, it was decided to include a 1 pct buffer (DKK 164.505/EUR 22.051,61) to the amount in order to avoid that arrear administration fees in the following month would turn the MSCA negative again and require another replenishment.
The DKK amount below has been calculated on a 100:750 EUR-DKK exchange rate to allow for small currency fluctuations.
